## Environment and controls

| Tool | Arguments | Effect | Use | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `system_status` | — | Inspect | Detect OS, CPU, Python and bridge availability. Does not start recording. | [engine.py](../../full_automation/engine.py) |
| `system_stop` | — | May change state | Set the persistent emergency stop flag. Current OS calls cannot be undone. | [engine.py](../../full_automation/engine.py) |
| `system_resume` | — | May change state | Clear the emergency stop flag after inspecting the device. | [engine.py](../../full_automation/engine.py) |
| `system_launch` | `executable*: string`, `arguments: array`, `cwd: string` | May change state | Launch an installed executable with a literal argument array; no shell interpolation. | [engine.py](../../full_automation/engine.py) |

## Chrome and CDP

| Tool | Arguments | Effect | Use | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `browser_connect` | `endpoint: string="http://127.0.0.1:9222"` | May change state | Connect explicitly to a loopback Chrome CDP endpoint. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_launch` | `executable: string`, `port: integer=9222`, `headless: boolean=false` | May change state | Start installed Chrome with a dedicated automation profile and local debugging port. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_tabs` | — | Inspect | List browser targets and their IDs. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_new_tab` | `url: string="about:blank"` | May change state | Create a Chrome tab. Save targetId for subsequent actions. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_navigate` | `target_id*: string`, `url*: string`, `timeout: number=30` | May change state | Navigate a tab and wait for document readiness. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_snapshot` | `target_id*: string`, `frame_id: string` | Inspect | Read visible text and unique CSS selectors, including open shadow roots. frame_id reads a specific frame. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_click` | `target_id*: string`, `selector*: string/array`, `button: string="left"`, `count: integer=1` | May change state | Click one unique visible CSS selector with trusted CDP mouse input; top frame or open shadow roots. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_fill` | `target_id*: string`, `selector*: string/array`, `text*: string` | May change state | Replace an editable field and verify its value. Password values are not returned. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_key` | `target_id*: string`, `key*: string`, `modifiers: integer=0` | May change state | Send a key; modifier mask: Alt=1 Ctrl=2 Meta=4 Shift=8. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_select` | `target_id*: string`, `selector*: string/array`, `value*: any` | May change state | Choose a native select option by value. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_scroll` | `target_id*: string`, `x: number=0`, `y: number=600` | May change state | Scroll the top-frame viewport. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_screenshot` | `target_id*: string` | Inspect | Return the viewport as an MCP image. It may contain private on-screen information. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_evaluate` | `target_id*: string`, `expression*: string`, `frame_id: string` | May change state | Run explicitly supplied JavaScript in a page or selected frame; may change page state. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_wait` | `target_id*: string`, `selector: string/array`, `expression: string`, `timeout: number=20` | May change state | Wait for a unique selector or a trusted JavaScript condition. Expressions can change page state. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_upload` | `target_id*: string`, `selector*: string/array`, `files*: array` | May change state | Set a file input to explicit local files. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_downloads` | `directory*: string` | May change state | Set a local download directory and enable progress events. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_events` | `target_id: string`, `clear: boolean=true` | Inspect | Read buffered CDP notifications. Enable desired domains with browser_cdp first. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_cdp` | `method*: string`, `params: object`, `target_id: string`, `session_id: string`, `timeout: number=20` | May change state | Call any CDP method with explicit params. Supports flattened session_id for attached targets, frames, network and dialogs. | [cdp.py](../../full_automation/cdp.py) |
| `browser_demo_start` | `target_id*: string`, `name*: string` | May change state | Watch a person work in one Chrome tab: record their clicks, typing, selections, uploads, Enter/Escape and navigation with unique selectors. Shows a visible badge; passwords are never captured. | [demo.py](../../full_automation/demo.py) |
| `browser_demo_read` | `cursor: integer=0`, `limit: integer=100` | Inspect | Follow a running Chrome demonstration live: read observed events from a cursor. | [demo.py](../../full_automation/demo.py) |
| `browser_demo_stop` | `save: boolean=true` | May change state | Stop the Chrome demonstration and convert it to a workflow: typed values become inputs, passwords become environment variables, untranslatable actions become manual steps. | [demo.py](../../full_automation/demo.py) |

## Windows desktop

| Tool | Arguments | Effect | Use | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `desktop_windows` | — | Inspect | List visible Windows titles, handles, PIDs and executable paths. | [engine.py](../../full_automation/engine.py) |
| `desktop_snapshot` | `window*: object`, `limit: integer=300` | Inspect | Read Windows UI Automation elements and visible terminal text, where exposed by the application. | [engine.py](../../full_automation/engine.py) |
| `desktop_screenshot` | `window: object` | Inspect | Capture the desktop or chosen window. Images are returned to the requesting agent. | [engine.py](../../full_automation/engine.py) |
| `desktop_focus` | `window*: object` | May change state | Bring one exact window into the foreground. | [engine.py](../../full_automation/engine.py) |
| `desktop_action` | `selector*: object`, `action: string="invoke"` | May change state | Act on one unique element: invoke, select, toggle, expand, collapse, focus, click, double_click, right_click. | [engine.py](../../full_automation/engine.py) |
| `desktop_fill` | `selector*: object`, `text*: string`, `allow_keyboard: boolean=false` | May change state | Set a Windows field. Optional explicit Unicode keyboard fallback requires result inspection. | [engine.py](../../full_automation/engine.py) |
| `desktop_keys` | `keys*: array`, `window: object` | May change state | Send a chord such as [CTRL,S] to an optional exact window. | [engine.py](../../full_automation/engine.py) |
| `desktop_mouse` | `x*: number`, `y*: number`, `action: string="click"`, `to_x: number=0`, `to_y: number=0`, `delta: integer=-120` | May change state | Use physical screenshot coordinates: move, click, right_click, double_click, drag, wheel. | [engine.py](../../full_automation/engine.py) |

## Managed agents and transcripts

| Tool | Arguments | Effect | Use | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agent_probe` | — | Inspect | Detect installed Claude, Codex, Cline, agy and configured custom CLI profiles. | [agents.py](../../full_automation/agents.py) |
| `agent_start` | `agent*: string`, `prompt*: string`, `cwd*: string`, `timeout: number=1800`, `model: string` | May change state | Start a managed non-interactive CLI task and capture its visible conversation. Uses the CLI's own login and permissions. | [agents.py](../../full_automation/agents.py) |

| `agent_list` | — | Inspect | List CLI sessions owned by this server instance. | [agents.py](../../full_automation/agents.py) |
| `agent_stop` | `session_id*: string` | May change state | Stop an owned CLI process tree. | [agents.py](../../full_automation/agents.py) |
| `transcript_read` | `path*: string`, `cursor: integer=0`, `limit: integer=100` | Inspect | Read an explicitly chosen saved conversation file; never scans credential directories. | [agents.py](../../full_automation/agents.py) |

## Workflows and run history

| Tool | Arguments | Effect | Use | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `workflow_save` | `definition*: object` | May change state | Validate and save a deterministic workflow; variables use ${name} or ${env:NAME}. | [workflows.py](../../full_automation/workflows.py) |
| `workflow_list` | — | Inspect | List saved deterministic workflows. | [workflows.py](../../full_automation/workflows.py) |
| `workflow_plan` | `name*: string`, `variables: object` | Inspect | Inspect a saved workflow's input requirements, blockers and possible write steps without running it. | [workflows.py](../../full_automation/workflows.py) |
| `workflow_run` | `name*: string`, `variables: object`, `expected_sha256: string`, `timeout: number=1800` | May change state | Run a saved workflow with checks, variables, branching, loops, bounded retries and an exclusive device lock. | [workflows.py](../../full_automation/workflows.py) |
| `workflow_start` | `name*: string`, `variables: object`, `expected_sha256: string`, `timeout: number=1800` | May change state | Start a long workflow in the background so MCP requests do not need to wait. Poll workflow_status. | [workflows.py](../../full_automation/workflows.py) |
| `workflow_status` | `job_id*: string` | Inspect | Read the status and result of an owned background workflow job. | [workflows.py](../../full_automation/workflows.py) |
| `workflow_cancel` | `job_id*: string` | May change state | Request cancellation of one owned background job at a checked boundary. | [workflows.py](../../full_automation/workflows.py) |
| `workflow_history` | `name: string`, `limit: integer=20` | Inspect | List persisted workflow run receipts, optionally by workflow name. | [history.py](../../full_automation/history.py) |
| `workflow_run_info` | `run_id*: string`, `cursor: integer=0`, `limit: integer=100` | Inspect | Read one run receipt and its step metadata using a sequence cursor. | [history.py](../../full_automation/history.py) |
| `workflow_record_start` | `name*: string`, `parameterize_inputs: boolean=true` | May change state | Record this agent's subsequent tool calls as a reusable workflow. Input values are parameterized by default. | [workflows.py](../../full_automation/workflows.py) |
| `workflow_record_stop` | — | May change state | Save the agent action recording as an editable workflow definition. | [workflows.py](../../full_automation/workflows.py) |
| `workflow_import_recording` | `path*: string`, `name*: string` | May change state | Convert an encrypted desktop recording to a workflow. Unsupported actions remain explicit manual barriers. | [workflows.py](../../full_automation/workflows.py) |
| `workflow_export` | `name*: string` | May change state | Export a saved workflow to inspectable Python source. | [workflows.py](../../full_automation/workflows.py) |
